metadata.description: Brian Lopez's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Structured reasoning and sequential thinking skills for complex problem-solving, planning, and analysis. Replaces sequential-thinking MCP with zero-latency prompt-based approach.

plugins.name: learning-mode
plugins.description: Educational interaction modes that help developers learn instead of just getting answers. Includes /teach, /pair, /review, /hints, and /quiz commands plus CLAUDE.md templates for enforcing learning-first behavior.

plugins.name: ux-patterns
plugins.description: Domain UX pattern skills for Claude Code. Vertical-specific UX conventions that generic design reviewers structurally cannot catch. Fitness vertical v1 covers 12 patterns (class booking, schedule grids, capacity signals, waitlists, instructor affinity, kiosk check-in, intro-offer funnels, package credits, multi-location, mobile-first, pricing tiers, recurring membership). Cited by design-review skills to surface domain-specific anti-patterns with named citations and measurable checks.

plugins.name: project-update-router
plugins.description: Routes project-update authoring (partner syncs, client status, architecture walkthroughs, strategic-pivot notes, retrospectives, investor updates) to the right artifact format — interactive microsite, long-form doc, Slidev, dashboard, hybrid PPTX — based on audience + distribution + content-shape + sensitivity. Scaffolds content from beads + git log + gstack learnings. Replaces PPTX-for-everything muscle memory with format choice that matches message. v0.2.0 adds Extension Consumer Protocol (consumes `.claude/plugins/*-update/` sibling plugins) + formalized Auto-pull Protocol. Still interpreter-mode; automated generators land in v0.3+.
